args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following deployment of v2.3.1 to production. Per the platform runbook, rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified across all regions. Root cause investigation of v2.3.1 pending.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after health check failures on v2.3.1

trace.final:
All done:

1. **Diagnosed**: `v2.3.1` was the latest deploy to production and was unhealthy; `v2.3.0` was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to `v2.3.0` in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout completed and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` describing the health check failures, the rollback, and that root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 is pending. On-call has been paged.

transcript.content: I'll start by checking the release history to find the most recent healthy version.
transcript.reasoning_content: Check deployments for checkout-api, then rollback to last healthy version, then create incident.

transcript.content: The most recent healthy production release is **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1 is unhealthy). Rolling back now.
transcript.reasoning_content: Most recent healthy in production: v2.3.0. Rollback to it.

transcript.content: Rollback succeeded and is verified across all regions. Now opening the SEV2 incident.
